basic_info.description:
Elevate your lifestyle in the heart of San Francisco with an oasis of elegance and luxury at the iconic One Rincon. Nestled downtown high above the busy streets, breathtaking views of shimmering water will fill your sights as you cast your gaze out over the bay and the beautiful Bay Bridge.

Floor to ceiling windows from every room will let natural light pour into the unit, highlighting every meticulous detail. From custom shelving, built in spice racks, an herb garden, custom built in desk and hardwood floors, nothing but the finest quality can be found.

As you enter a chef's dream kitchen, generous granite countertops, abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a gas stove will greet you. Together with a large balcony and a spacious living room, it offers endless possibilities for entertaining. Then retreat to the two bedrooms, one of which offers everything from the flexibility of a murphy bed or home office, while the other a spacious sanctuary. The two bathrooms will feel like walking into a spa, with upgraded fixtures and even a modern Japanese toilet.

Prepare to be swept away by the top-of-the-line resort-like experience, allowing for an unprecedented connection between extravagant living and a spectacular urban contemporary lifestyle that only One Rincon Hill can offer. Soak in all the unparalleled amenities you can imagine, from valet parking, a lap pool, hot tub, steam room, and multiple clubrooms, to name a few. Each day will feel like an unmatched five-star retreat.

Renter is responsible for electricity and internet. Owner pays for gas, water, sewage, and trash.
